rules: preliminary (SAY/EXAM/DIAGNOSE, no TEST), competition retrieval, mock LLM
authoring: engineering agent, single author (no independent author available), labels fixed from the vignette before any run; not clinician-adjudicated; not independent validation
label_note: labels use the existing same_diagnosis() matcher unchanged; e.g. 'heart_failure' does not match 'Congestive Heart Failure' under that matcher
policy: run at Round P baseline and at the end of Round P only (plus once under the EXAM-rejection scenario)
